name: Tricon Residential (Tricon Homes)
notes: Researched from public triconhomes.com pages (Resident Support, FAQ hub, Rent Payments FAQ incl. its FAQPage JSON-LD, Notice to Vacate FAQ). Residents pay in the Tricon Resident App / resident portal at secure.triconhomes.com (sign-in: Email Address + Password, Continue with Google / Apple - observed by the reviewer); an Alternative Resident Portal (RentCafe) exists for transferring residents. Rent due on the 1st; grace period varies by state/lease (late fee amount not published - not modelled). Bank payments free; card processing fee 'small' and unpublished (fees.notes). Cash only via WIPS (number from 844-874-2661; retailer fee); certified funds by mail to P.O. Box 15087, Attn: Accounts Receivable, Santa Ana, CA 92735; postmark does not count. No wire, Venmo or Zelle. Max two NSF; after the second, online payments are blocked for 12 months (certified funds/WIPS only) - not expressible as a rule. Payment arrangement / one-time courtesy late-fee waiver by phone when benefit income arrives after the 1st. Move-out: Notice to Vacate e-signed by all leaseholders, most leases 60 days.

pay_online.note: Pay in the Tricon Resident App with a bank account (free) or a debit/credit card (a small processing fee may apply).

autopay.note: Open the Auto-Pay Setup tab, choose your payment account, start date and pay date, review the terms and select Set Up Auto-Pay.

pay_by_mail.note: Mail a money order or cashier's check with your name and property address to Tricon Homes, P.O. Box 15087, Attn: Accounts Receivable, Santa Ana, CA 92735. It must arrive before the grace period ends; postmarks do not count.

payment_arrangement.note: Payment arrangements are not set up online. If your income arrives after the 1st, call 844-874-2661 early to ask about an arrangement or a one-time courtesy late fee waiver.

cancel_service.note: Submit an official Notice to Vacate, e-signed by all leaseholders. Most leases require at least 60 days' written notice.

help.title: Ways to pay your rent
paragraphs: Rent is due on the 1st of each month. Most states allow a grace period before a late fee applies; check your lease for the rules where you live.

Pay online in the Tricon Resident App with a bank account (no fee) or a debit or credit card (a small processing fee may apply), or set up automatic monthly payments. You can also pay cash through WIPS at retailers such as Walmart and Kroger, split rent into two payments with Flex, or mail a money order or cashier's check. Tricon does not take wire transfers, Venmo or Zelle.

help.title: Setting up Auto-Pay
paragraphs: Automatic rent payments are set up in the Tricon Resident App.
steps: Log in to the Tricon Resident App.
Choose your payment account, start date and pay date.
Review the terms and select Set Up Auto-Pay.

help.title: Paying cash with WIPS
paragraphs: Cash is accepted only through the Walk-In Payment System (WIPS) at participating retailers such as Walmart and Kroger, never by mail or at a Tricon office. Call 844-874-2661 to get your WIPS account number, show the number or barcode at checkout and keep the receipt. A small service fee applies and payments usually post within 24 hours.

help.title: Paying by mail
paragraphs: Mail a money order or cashier's check to Tricon Homes, P.O. Box 15087, Attn: Accounts Receivable, Santa Ana, CA 92735, with your name and property address. A mailed payment counts as on time only if it is received before the grace period ends; the postmark date does not count.

help.title: Returned payments and NSF
paragraphs: An NSF (non-sufficient funds) charge is added when your bank returns a payment, and a replacement payment is required within a limited time.

Residents may have at most two NSF occurrences. After the second, online payments are blocked for 12 months from that date and rent must be paid with certified funds or through WIPS. If the return was a bank or processing error, the restriction may be reviewed with documentation from your bank.

help.title: If your income arrives after the 1st
paragraphs: If your SSI or other benefit payment arrives after the due date, tell Tricon as early as you can at 844-874-2661. Depending on your situation the team may arrange a payment plan or give a one-time courtesy late fee waiver.

help.title: Giving notice to vacate
paragraphs: To move out, submit an official Notice to Vacate, electronically signed by every leaseholder. Most leases require at least 60 days' written notice; some states allow less, so check your lease.

The notice asks for your reason for moving, a forwarding address for your Move-Out Statement and any refund, and whether you want an optional Pre-Move-Out Inspection. Tricon then sends move-out instructions.

help.title: Contact Tricon
paragraphs: Call the Resident Experience team at 844-874-2661 (weekdays 8 a.m. to 9 p.m. ET, weekends 9 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. ET), or chat live with the team weekdays 9 a.m. to 8 p.m. ET. You can also send a message from Resident Support. Tricon's address is 15771 Red Hill Ave, Tustin, CA 92780.
